001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006/**
007 * Manages ships on a square board and validates their placement when added.
008 * Ships must lie within the board and cannot overlap or touch, even diagonally.
009 * The fleet also supports category filtering, position lookup and status output.
010 */
011public class Fleet implements IFleet {
012    /**
013     * This operation prints all the given ships
014     *
015     * @param ships The list of ships
016     */
017    static void printShips(List<IShip> ships) {
018        for (IShip ship : ships)
019            System.out.println(ship);
020    }
021
022    // -----------------------------------------------------
023
024    /** Ships in insertion order, including ships that have been sunk. */
025    private List<IShip> ships;
026
027    /** Creates an empty fleet. */
028    public Fleet() {
029        ships = new ArrayList<>();
030    }
031
032    /**
033     * {@inheritDoc}
034     */
035    @Override
036    public List<IShip> getShips() {
037        return ships;
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * {@inheritDoc}
042     *
043     * <p>The capacity check accepts an insertion while the existing number of
044     * ships is less than or equal to {@link #FLEET_SIZE}.</p>
045     */
046    @Override
047    public boolean addShip(IShip s) {
048        boolean result = false;
049        if ((ships.size() <= FLEET_SIZE) && (isInsideBoard(s)) && (!colisionRisk(s))) {
050            ships.add(s);
051            result = true;
052        }
053        return result;
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * {@inheritDoc}
058     */
059    @Override
060    public List<IShip> getShipsLike(String category) {
061        List<IShip> shipsLike = new ArrayList<>();
062        for (IShip s : ships)
063            if (s.getCategory().equals(category))
064                shipsLike.add(s);
065
066        return shipsLike;
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * {@inheritDoc}
071     */
072    @Override
073    public List<IShip> getFloatingShips() {
074        List<IShip> floatingShips = new ArrayList<>();
075        for (IShip s : ships)
076            if (s.stillFloating())
077                floatingShips.add(s);
078
079        return floatingShips;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * {@inheritDoc}
084     */
085    @Override
086    public IShip shipAt(IPosition pos) {
087        for (int i = 0; i < ships.size(); i++)
088            if (ships.get(i).occupies(pos))
089                return ships.get(i);
090        return null;
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * Checks that all ship boundaries fall within the board's zero-based indices.
095     *
096     * @param s the ship whose placement is checked
097     * @return {@code true} if all occupied positions are inside the board
098     */
099    private boolean isInsideBoard(IShip s) {
100        return (s.getLeftMostPos() >= 0 && s.getRightMostPos() <= BOARD_SIZE - 1 && s.getTopMostPos() >= 0
101                && s.getBottomMostPos() <= BOARD_SIZE - 1);
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * Checks whether a proposed ship overlaps or touches a ship already in the fleet.
106     *
107     * @param s the proposed ship
108     * @return {@code true} if an overlap or adjacency, including diagonal contact, exists
109     */
110    private boolean colisionRisk(IShip s) {
111        for (int i = 0; i < ships.size(); i++) {
112            if (ships.get(i).tooCloseTo(s))
113                return true;
114        }
115        return false;
116    }
117
118
119    /**
120     * This operation shows the state of a fleet
121     */
122    public void printStatus() {
123        printAllShips();
124        printFloatingShips();
125        printShipsByCategory("Galeao");
126        printShipsByCategory("Fragata");
127        printShipsByCategory("Nau");
128        printShipsByCategory("Caravela");
129        printShipsByCategory("Barca");
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * This operation prints all the ships of a fleet belonging to a particular
134     * category
135     *
136     * @param category The category of ships of interest
137     */
138    public void printShipsByCategory(String category) {
139        assert category != null;
140
141        printShips(getShipsLike(category));
142    }
143
144    /**
145     * This operation prints all the ships of a fleet but not yet shot
146     */
147    public void printFloatingShips() {
148        printShips(getFloatingShips());
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * This operation prints all the ships of a fleet
153     */
154    void printAllShips() {
155        printShips(ships);
156    }
157
158}
